messages:
maria.g: Quick ask — can runtime team do a lightweight spot-check of the launch cohort we're using for the upcoming product post? We need latency p95, coldstart heatmap, and a couple of sample responses for the press pack.

sam.runtime: Sure — what's the exact cohort/spec? small-ish: ~200 requests, mix of short/long prompts, 2 quantization modes (fp16 + q4_0). Want both gen and embeddings.

alex.marketing: Thanks! Priorities: 1) p95 and p99 for gen paths 2) coldstart heatmap across regions 3) 6 raw samples (1 short, 1 medium, 1 long) showing model parity vs our internal baseline. Can we get CSV with per-request metadata?

maria.g: CSV would be ideal. Also we want one run with a warmed cache + one genuinely cold run. Label them clearly for reproducibility.

sam.runtime: Got it. Two runs: warm and cold. Which model variant and sequence length cap?

maria.g: Use rdl-13B-v1 for the main numbers and rdl-13B-q4_0 for the quantized comparison. Sequence cap 2048.

jess: Heads-up — marketing will use the sample outputs in a launch blog and a webinar slide. Please redact any customer data. Also need an evaluation note if outputs differ noticeably.

sam.runtime: Noted re: redaction. We'll run on staging Dedicated cluster (us-west2) and capture console traces. We'll attach the trace IDs in the CSV.

alex.marketing: Can you also include a tiny snippet of the run command or curl payload we can paste into the docs? Something like:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rdl-13B-v1","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":150}'
```

sam.runtime: Yep. We'll produce a 'runbook' zip with: metrics.csv, sample-responses.jsonl, run-commands.txt, and a short README describing warm vs cold methodology.

maria.g: ETA?

sam.runtime: Expect initial artifacts by EOD tomorrow. If we hit capacity will push to Friday AM. I'll ping if blocked. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: scheduled cluster job started (job_id: run-ops-4829) — logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/run-ops-4829

alex.marketing: Awesome. small ask: can one of the samples highlight a failure mode (hallucination / repetition) so we can be transparent in the webinar?

sam.runtime: We'll include a flagged example if present. If nothing obvious shows up, we'll include a note saying cohort didn't reveal major regressions.

maria.g: Thanks all. Please drop artifacts to /handoffs/marketing/launch-cohort-2026-03 and mark artifacts with run_ts and run_id.

sam.runtime: Will do. ping me directly if you need faster turnaround — sam.runtime
